about: Landing sites. Planned targets are written as 'Place (mission target)'. snapped = the highest ground within 600 m of the nominal point on the 80 m DEM.

sites.name: Shackleton rim
sites.note: One of the most sunlit points near the pole, on the crater rim (LOLA Site 04).
sites.snap_note: Placed on the highest ground within 600 m on the 80 m DEM.

sites.name: Connecting ridge (Blue Moon MK1 target)
sites.note: Ridge between Shackleton and de Gerlache (LOLA Site 01). Blue Origin's MK1 pathfinder is aimed here; launch slipped to 2027.
sites.snap_note: Placed on the highest ground within 600 m on the 80 m DEM.

sites.name: de Gerlache rim (Artemis III candidate)
sites.note: Rim of de Gerlache crater (LOLA Site 11), inside one of NASA's Artemis III candidate regions.
sites.snap_note: Placed on the highest ground within 600 m on the 80 m DEM.

sites.name: Shackleton rim (Chang'e 7 target)
sites.note: Published target for China's Chang'e 7 lander. The August 2026 launch was called off; now expected in 2027.

sites.name: Malapert Massif (Artemis III candidate)
sites.note: One of NASA's Artemis III candidate regions (LOLA Site 23).
sites.snap_note: Placed on the highest ground within 600 m on the 80 m DEM.

sites.name: Mons Mouton (VIPER target)
sites.note: Planned area for NASA's VIPER rover, now set to ride on Blue Origin's second MK1 lander.

sites.name: Mons Mouton (IM-2 landing, 2025)
sites.note: Intuitive Machines' Athena landed here on 6 March 2025 and tipped over.

sites.name: Malapert A (IM-1 landing, 2024)
sites.note: Intuitive Machines' Odysseus landed here on 22 February 2024.

sites.name: South pole
sites.note: The geographic pole, on the wall of Shackleton crater.

sites.name: Reiner Gamma (IM-3 target)
sites.note: Intuitive Machines IM-3, planned for early 2027. Coordinates approximate.

sites.name: Far side (Blue Ghost Mission 2 target)
sites.note: Firefly lists Nassau crater on the far side; planned for 2027. Coordinates approximate.

sites.name: Gruithuisen Domes (Blue Ghost Mission 3 target)
sites.note: Firefly CLPS task order. Coordinates approximate.

sites.name: Schrödinger basin (ispace Mission 3 target)
sites.note: ispace-U.S. APEX 1.0 lander, NASA CLPS delivery to the far side. Basin centre shown.

sites.name: Apollo 11, Tranquility Base
sites.note: First crewed landing, July 1969. Kept as a near-equator comparison.

sites.name: Von Kármán crater (Chang'e 4)
sites.note: First landing on the far side, January 2019.

sites.name: Shiv Shakti point (Chandrayaan-3)
sites.note: ISRO's Vikram, August 2023. The furthest south anyone had landed at the time.
